description: Index of brand logos. Pick a version by the background the logo sits on.

selection_rules.light_background: full (default) — or black for monochrome contexts
selection_rules.photo_or_busy_background: white over the darker area, with a scrim if needed
selection_rules.never: white logo on light bg (invisible); color/black logo on dark bg (disappears)
